header.reason: Ines, the new CFO, signed after Wen priced her team's hand-matching of deposits using her own statements. Dana first pitched the ordering portal, which Ines said wasn't her problem.

findings.label: What started it
findings.finding: Lead with a slow month-end close, not the ordering portal.

line.text: Stripe automates the tedious parts of revenue reporting and reconciliation, so teams spend less time closing the books

findings.why: Ines's first close took nine days, partly from hand-matching deposits. The portal pitch cost Dana a month.
findings.quote: her first month-end close took nine days.

findings.label: Who decided
findings.finding: Open with closing the books faster, written for the CFO.

line.text: Stripe automates the tedious parts of revenue reporting and reconciliation, so teams spend less time closing the books

findings.why: Ines read only the first page of the portal proposal and set it aside for three weeks.
findings.quote: she read the first page and said it wasn't her problem.

findings.label: The competitor
findings.finding: Answer who helps me with a named contact, not rates.

line.text: Premium support: a dedicated support manager who has ongoing context about your business

findings.why: Ines's bank only offered a rate review, then she asked us for a named contact. Dana never saw Fiserv's pitch.
findings.quote: I didn't ask about my rates.

findings.label: Our message
findings.finding: Replace the global growth opener with payout-to-transaction matching.
findings.why: The global deck got silence from Paul. Ines interrupted Wen's payout matching demo to see it again.
findings.quote: Ines actually stopped him and said, 'go back.'

findings.label: Missing proof
findings.finding: Add a wholesale distributor customer story.
findings.why: Ines asked twice to talk to another distributor and brushed off the retail case study Dana sent.
findings.quote: this is a company that sells sweaters.

findings.label: Their words
findings.finding: Say 'where my money is' and 'deposits', not 'infrastructure'.

line.text: Financial infrastructure to grow your revenue

findings.why: Ines never said 'payments' or 'infrastructure'. She talked about the deposits and where her money was.
findings.quote: I just want to know where my money is.
